_source: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56 (Allen, Pereira, Raes, Smith, 1998), Chapter 6. Kc values from Table 12; stage lengths from Table 11. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0b.htm
_rules: Where Table 12 gives no Kc ini for a crop, the crop-group value from Table 12 is used (legumes 0.4, cereals 0.3, oil crops 0.35, fibre crops 0.35).
Where Table 12 gives a range, the midpoint is used, except where a footnote assigns the second value to dry harvest; then the dry-harvest value is used.
Stage lengths in Table 11 come from other regions. They are starting values and need review against varieties grown in Andhra Pradesh.

groundnut.name: Groundnut
groundnut.kc_note: Table 12: mid 1.15, end 0.60; ini from legume group (0.4).
groundnut.stages_note: Table 11: West Africa, dry season, 130 days.

green_gram.name: Green gram
green_gram.kc_note: Table 12 'Green gram and cowpeas': mid 1.05, end 0.60-0.35 (0.35 is for dry harvest); ini from legume group.
green_gram.stages_note: Table 11: Mediterranean, March planting (listed total 110; the stages add to 100; the stage values are used). Varieties grown in India are usually shorter; needs local review.

chickpea.name: Chickpea (Bengal gram)
chickpea.kc_note: Table 12 'Chick pea': mid 1.00, end 0.35; ini from legume group.
chickpea.stages_note: NOT in Table 11. Stage lengths are a placeholder (105 days) and are unverified.

millet.name: Millet
millet.kc_note: Table 12: mid 1.00, end 0.30; ini from cereal group (0.3).

sorghum.name: Sorghum (jowar)
sorghum.kc_note: Table 12 'Sorghum, grain': mid 1.00-1.10 (midpoint 1.05), end 0.55; ini from cereal group.
sorghum.stages_note: Table 11: USA, Pakistan, Mediterranean, May/June planting (listed total 130; the stages add to 125; the stage values are used).

maize.name: Maize
maize.kc_note: Table 12 'Maize, field (grain)': mid 1.20, end 0.60-0.35 (0.35 is for harvest after field drying); ini from cereal group.
maize.stages_note: Table 11: India (dry, cool), October planting, 125 days; the Nigeria (humid) June row is identical.

sesame.name: Sesame
sesame.kc_note: Table 12: mid 1.10, end 0.25; ini from oil-crop group (0.35).
sesame.stages_note: Table 11: China, June planting (listed total 100; the stages add to 110; the stage values are used).

cotton.name: Cotton
cotton.kc_note: Table 12: mid 1.15-1.20 (midpoint 1.175), end 0.70-0.50 (midpoint 0.60); ini from fibre-crop group.
cotton.stages_note: Table 11: Egypt, Pakistan, California, March-May planting, 195 days.

black_gram.name: Black gram
black_gram.kc_note: NOT in FAO-56 Table 12. Uses the 'Green gram and cowpeas' row as a stand-in for a closely related pulse.
black_gram.stages_note: NOT in FAO-56 Table 11. Uses the green gram row as a stand-in.
